name: Prince Albert National Park
policyReason: Leashed pets are welcome, including on most beaches outside buoyed swimming areas.
summary: Leashed pets are welcome, including on most beaches outside buoyed swimming areas.

excerpts.quote: Pets are part of the family and are welcome in Prince Albert National Park.
For visitors who do choose to bring domestic animals to Prince Albert National Park, they must be on a leash and under physical control at all times.

dogRules.text: Dogs are allowed on most beaches, outside buoyed swimming areas.
All five frontcountry campgrounds and 15 backcountry campgrounds are pet-friendly.
Keep pets leashed; bears have had encounters with pets in Waskesiu and at Kingsmere Lake.
